protocol: Two fixed profiles, no per-document tuning. PSM6 is tried once only for whitespace-empty first output. No rotation, denoising, binarization, answer repair or model calls.
decision: Offline experiment only; application defaults remain 220DPI/no retry regardless of results. Numeric and table correctness require review; do not promote by text length.
limitations: Only sampled pages, not full-document accuracy.
All are public scanner PDFs; three documents do not establish broad generalization.
Existing 150-anchor chunk baseline remains untouched; this measures OCR page text only.
